journal:
# Hamad (p06) — BodyTracker journal

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup was clear. Entered 186 cm, 24 y, 94.6 kg, male, 10,000 steps -> it suggested "Very active", which matches my 6x/week training anyway. Picked Very active. Entered BIA 30.8% body fat in profile, answered "Yes" to 2+ weeks at current intake. Weekly update day Sun.
- After saving profile, the home card showed Body Fat "—" even though I had typed 30.8% into the profile. Only after adding a weigh-in with body fat did it show 30.8. Minor, but I expected the profile value to show.
- Confusion: tapping the word "Weight" on the home screen opened the weight trend chart, not the entry form. The add button is "+ Weight" (the label reads "+ + Weight Weight" oddly). Took me a second.
- Tape: waist 94.9, neck 38.3. Body composition screen gave a "US Navy tape estimate: 22%" while my BIA says 30.8%. Big gap — which one is right? App says the Navy number is for reference only, fine.
- Nutrition started on goal "Maintain" (target = 3,080!). I had to find the gear icon to switch to Lose. Default 0.5%/wk -> target 2,580 kcal. Maintenance shown 3,080 ± 720, "Estimated, 0% from your data".
- Surprise: the app says I should eat 2,580, but I've been eating ~2,250 for a month. The ± 720 is huge and it says it's mostly formula, so I won't change anything until it learns from my data. Keeping my normal diet.
- "Explain the math" is very detailed (Katch-McArdle, Kalman filter, Hall 2008). I actually like that.
- Protein target 139 g = 1.8 g/kg × "77 kg reference weight". Not sure what reference weight is (I weigh 94.6). Probably lean-ish weight. Would like one line explaining it.
- Logged 4 meals with macros (1,877 kcal, 140 g protein), ticked "Day complete". Logging form is quick.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Weighed 95.1 (BIA 27.9%, fat 26.5, muscle 36.0). Home card immediately shows "Fat Mass ▼ 2.6 kg, Muscle ▲ 1.3 kg" vs first. I know my BIA scale jumps around, but the app shows this one-day noise with big arrows like it's real progress. The body composition detail screen is careful (needs 3+3 readings 21 days apart), the home card isn't.
- Trend weight stayed 94.6 while scale said 95.1 — good, it's smoothing.
- Recommendation box still says "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" on day 2. I guess it's frozen until the Sunday update, but "day 1 so far" reads wrong.
- Logged 4 meals, 2,520 kcal, 200 g protein; day complete. Avg intake now 2,199.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- 94.4 kg, BIA 29.4%. Big eating day: 3,298 kcal (kabsa + pizza). Logged it honestly.
- Breakfast (eggs & toast) I only had kcal + protein, no carbs/fat. After that, the food log's "Day total" line dropped carbs and fat completely ("Day total: 2108 kcal · 204 g protein") even though the other meals had carbs/fat. I expected it to sum the ones I entered (maybe with a note that one meal is missing them).
- Avg intake now 2,565 over 3 complete days.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- 93.4 kg, BIA 32.2% (!). My BIA jumped from 29.4 to 32.2 overnight — home card now says Fat Mass ▲ 1 kg vs first. This is exactly why I don't trust single BIA readings. Trend weight 94.5.
- Meals 2,396 kcal, logged + complete. Nutrition page shows macro targets: protein 139 g, carbs ~376 g, fat ≥57 g. I'm way over on protein (avg 214 g) which is fine by me.
- "Last 14 days" list is a nice overview.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- 93.6 kg, BIA 32.0%. Trend 94.4. The app opened this morning on the Body tab scrolled half-way down (tape list / Recent entries) — had to scroll up to find "+ Weight". Minor.
- Lighter day: 1,849 kcal. Logged + complete.

## Day 6 (Fri)
- 94.0 kg, BIA 28.6%. Home card: Muscle Mass "• 0 kg", Fat ▼ 2.2 kg vs first — BIA bouncing between 27.9 and 32.2 all week.
- 2,645 kcal logged, complete. My week is averaging ~2,430, a bit more than I thought I was eating (I believed ~2,250). Logging everything is eye-opening.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 95.0 kg, BIA 28.3%. Trend 94.4. 2,509 kcal logged + complete. 7/7 days complete, avg intake 2,442, protein avg 202 g.
- The recommendation only refreshes on Sundays, so I'll do my weekly review tomorrow morning after the update.

## Week 1 (review Sun 2026-10-11, morning, after weekly update)
- App says: maintenance 3,030 ± 680 kcal/day (Estimated, 11% from my data). Target 2,530 (lose 0.5%/wk). Avg intake 2,536 (6 of last 7 complete — today not logged yet). Trend -0.56 kg/week (95%: -1.21 to +0.10). Protein target 141 g (1.8 g/kg × 78.2 kg reference = lean mass ÷ 0.85, explained in the math page — good). Recommendation: "Suggested intake 2,530. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)." No warnings.
- My understanding: I'm eating right at the target already and losing ~0.5 kg/week, which is what I want. The ± is still wide, so it's early.
- Decision: no change, keep eating like I do (~2,450–2,550). No `plan` change.
- Small oddities: the regression "cross-check" says "daily weight over 2026-09-14 → 2026-10-11 (7 weigh-ins)" — I only started 10-04, so why 09-14? Also "Days with several weigh-ins: 1 used the earliest reading" — I never weighed twice; I think the profile's "current weight" was saved as a second weigh-in on day 1.
- Stepping back: I thought I was eating 2,250 a day; the log says ~2,440. Useful reality check.

From day 8 I'm using a small script in my folder (routine.mjs) that reads my day and taps/types through the app the same way I did by hand (weigh-in with BIA numbers, tape when I measure, 4 meals with macros, tick Day complete). I stop and look at the app every Sunday.

## Days 8–14 (batch)
- Day 8 (Sun): I checked the Recommendation at 06:45 right after the weekly update: target 2,530, maintenance 3,030 ± 680. After I logged Sunday's weigh-in and meals, by 21:30 the same card said target 2,650, maintenance 3,140 ± 670, 15% from data. The settings text promised "refresh once a week on this day, so they don't jump around" — but it changed within the update day itself, so what I see depends on whether I look before or after logging on Sunday. Confusing: which Sunday number is "the" weekly number?
- Day 9 (Mon 10-12): NOT logged at all (no weigh-in, no food). This was my own slip with my helper script (it moved to the next day before I'd logged), not the app's fault. The app correctly shows 10-12 as "not logged" and treats it as unknown.
- Days 10–14 logged by my script: weigh-in with BIA each morning, 4 meals with macros, day complete.

## Week 2 (review Sun 2026-10-18, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.90 to +0.13 kg per week) includes your target of −0.47 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,250 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,740 ± 550 (Estimated, 42% from my data). Target 2,250 (lose 0.5%/wk). Avg intake 2,132 (5 of last 7 complete). Rate -0.39 kg/week (14-day). Protein 143 g (79.3 kg reference).
- Warning on screen: "2026-10-14: macros add up to ~1928 kcal vs 2369 kcal logged (19% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I opened that day: every meal is ~18–20% short on macros vs kcal (numbers straight from my food apps/labels). Nice catch, but I can't tell which number is wrong, so I left it.
- Confusion: the headline says I'm losing 0.39 kg/week, but my own weight chart this week goes UP (93.7 on 10-11 → ~94.7–94.9 this week; trend line 94.5, basically flat since day 1). "Explain the math" even shows the straight-line fit is +35.9 g/day (gaining) and still says it "agrees with the filter". I don't get how I'm "on track" when the scale isn't moving. Screenshot of the chart: screens/1790455245422.png
- Maintenance dropped a lot (3,140 → 2,740), which does match the scale being flat while I eat ~2,300.
- Decision: follow the app. `plan 2250` — aim for exactly the suggested 2,250 kcal/day from tomorrow.

## Days 15–21 (batch)
- Day 15 (Sun 10-18): waist 91.9 cm (from 94.9), neck 39.2. US Navy estimate now 19.3%. After logging Sunday, target moved again the same evening: 2,250 (morning) → 2,170 (night), maintenance 2,740 → 2,670 ± 530. Same "changes during the update day" thing as week 1.
- I planned 2,250 but real life came out higher: 2,512 / 2,755 / 2,510 / 2,258 / 2,444 / 2,536 / 1,930. Scale 94.9 → 93.5.
- No new popups or warnings; the 10-14 macro warning disappeared on its own after a few days.

## Week 3 (review Sun 2026-10-25, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.79 to −0.01 kg per week) includes your target of −0.47 kg/week. Suggested intake 2,250 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,740 ± 420 — now labelled **Measured** (67% from my data). Target 2,250. Avg intake 2,406. Rate -0.40 kg/week. Protein 143 g.
- Body composition card still "Not enough data yet … needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 2)". I have 21 BIA readings spanning 21+ days by now, so "have 2" confused me. I think it's counting my 2 tape (waist) entries, since it says waist is the main signal — but it doesn't say which source it's counting. Still said "have 2" on Monday 10-26 too.
- Home card still shows raw first-vs-last BIA: Fat ▼ 3.2 kg, Muscle ▲ 0.2 kg — looks great but I know it's noisy.
- My understanding: I'm losing ~0.4 kg/week eating ~2,400; the app's number is now based mostly on my own data, so I trust it more. I overshot the 2,250 target by ~150/day.
- Decision: `plan 2250` again — recommit to the suggested 2,250.

## Days 22–28 (batch)
- Sun 10-25 evening the target again shifted after logging: 2,250 → 2,200 (maintenance 2,700).
- Intake: 2,395 / 1,895 / 2,502 / 2,071 / 2,100 / 2,260 / 2,445. Scale 94.0 → 91.6 low, 93.2 Saturday.
- No popups/warnings during the week.

## Week 4 (review Sun 2026-11-01, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.87 to −0.26 kg per week) includes your target of −0.47 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,420 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,910 ± 330 (Measured, 80% from my data). Target 2,420. Avg intake 2,212. Rate -0.57 kg/week. Protein 140 g (77.7 kg ref).
- Body composition finally has a verdict: "Confidence: medium. No measurable change yet" — BIA fat mass −0.8 kg (noise ±1.5), muscle −0.3 kg (±1.5), body fat −0.1% (±2), weight −2.4 kg. Makes sense and is honest.
- BUT it says "No waist data to cross-check against; add tape measurements for a stronger signal." I DID enter waist twice (94.9 on 10-04, 91.9 on 10-18 — a 3 cm drop, which is my best sign of fat loss!). Expected: it uses my waist, or says "need more waist readings". Actual: "No waist data". Possible bug / misleading wording. (Maybe it needs 3 waist readings at each end, like the scale — but then say so.)
- Maintenance went UP from 2,700 to 2,910 in a week, target up 2,200 → 2,420. I'm losing faster than planned, so the app tells me to eat more. That's sensible for keeping muscle.
- Decision: follow it — `plan 2420`.

## Days 29–35 (batch)
- Sun 11-01: waist 91.2 cm (3rd tape entry), neck 39.3. Lunch had no macros ("you don't know the macros") — logged kcal only. That evening target moved again 2,420 → 2,500 (maintenance 2,980).
- Intake: 2,550 / 2,187 / 2,466 / 2,287 / 2,003 / 2,401 / 2,710. Scale bounced 92.0 → 93.2. BIA 23.5%–30.0% (!) this week — my scale is all over the place.

## Week 5 (review Sun 2026-11-08, morning)
- New banner: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". Tapped Back up now → data screen (35 weigh-ins, 3 measurement entries, 136 food entries, 34 complete days, "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser"). Made a Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-11-08.json. Good nudge. (35 weigh-ins for 34 weigh-in days: the profile weight on day 1 counts as a separate weigh-in.)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.74 to −0.23 kg per week) includes your target of −0.47 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,330 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,810 ± 270 (Measured, 86%). Target 2,330. Avg intake 2,342. Rate -0.48 kg/week. Protein 145 g (80.6 kg ref).
- Body composition: "Confidence: medium — Losing fat. Fat signals are down; muscle has no measurable change." BIA fat mass 27.8 → 24.6 (−3.2 kg ± 1.5), muscle +0.1, body fat −2.9% (± 2), weight −1.7 kg. Happy with that, exactly my goal — though fat −3.2 kg with weight only −1.7 kg and muscle flat doesn't quite add up; the last-3 BIA average includes a 23.5% reading. Still says "No waist data to cross-check against" although I now have 3 waist entries (94.9 → 91.9 → 91.2).
- Target has been 2,250 → 2,200 → 2,420 → 2,500 → 2,330 week to week (counting the Sunday-evening shifts). A bit jumpy but ±100–200.
- Decision: `plan 2330`.

## Days 36–42 (batch)
- Sun 11-08 evening: target shifted 2,330 → 2,280 (maintenance 2,760) after logging the day.
- Intake: 2,833 / 2,121 / 2,090 / 2,459 / 2,481 / 1,892 / 2,151. Scale 93.7 → 90.9 low (Thu) → 92.4.
- New warning from 11-10: "macros add up to ~1738 kcal vs 2090 kcal logged (17% apart)". Same story as 10-14 — numbers copied from my food apps, can't tell which is wrong. It hangs around on the Nutrition screen for a week with no way to dismiss it or mark it "checked".

## Week 6 (review Sun 2026-11-15, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.78 to −0.23 kg per week) includes your target of −0.46 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,380 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,860 ± 280 (Measured, 85%). Target 2,380. Avg intake 2,199. Rate -0.51 kg/week. Protein 143 g.
- Body comp: still "Losing fat, medium confidence; muscle no measurable change".
- Every Sunday morning the card says "6 of last 7 days complete" only because today isn't logged yet — made me double-check I hadn't missed a day.
- Decision: `plan 2380` (the app's suggestion).

## Days 43–49 (batch)
- Sun 11-15: waist 92.1 cm (4th tape entry; up a bit from 91.2), neck 38.2 → Navy estimate 20.2%. Evening target 2,380 → 2,390.
- Intake: 1,939 / 2,692 / 2,785 / 2,453 / 2,130 / 2,628 / 2,241 — overshot my plan a few days. Scale 92.7 → 91.3.
- The 11-10 macro warning disappeared by Tuesday. Nothing else new.

## Week 7 (review Sun 2026-11-22, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.73 to −0.23 kg per week) includes your target of −0.46 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,370 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,850 ± 250 (Measured, 88%). Target 2,370. Avg intake 2,488. Rate -0.48 kg/week. Protein 143 g ("average of 5 complete days with protein logged" — one day had a meal without macros).
- Body comp: "Losing fat" (BIA fat mass −3.0 kg ± 1.5; muscle −0.6 kg, no measurable change; weight −2.8 kg). Still "No waist data to cross-check against" with 4 waist entries over 6 weeks. I now suspect it needs 3 waist readings at each end (6 total), but the wording "No waist data" is plain wrong from my point of view — I measure every 2 weeks as I was always told.
- Decision: `plan 2370`, tighten back to target.

## Days 50–56 (batch)
- Sun 11-22 evening: target 2,370 → 2,380.
- Intake: 2,079 / 2,110 / 2,478 / 2,633 / 2,618 / 2,853 / 2,158 — overshot most days. Scale ~91.
- New macro warning for 11-24 (macros ~2,854 vs 2,478 logged, 15% apart — this time macros are HIGHER than calories).

## Week 8 (review Sun 2026-11-29, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.64 to −0.18 kg per week) includes your target of −0.46 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,360 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,830 ± 230 (Measured, 90%). Target 2,360. Avg intake 2,475. Rate -0.41 kg/week. Protein 141 g.
- Body comp: "Losing fat", medium confidence; BIA fat mass −2.7 kg, muscle −1.0 kg (no measurable change, ±1.5).
- Waist today 90.9 cm — 5th tape entry over 8 weeks (94.9 → 91.9 → 91.2 → 92.1 → 90.9). Body composition STILL says "No waist data to cross-check against; add tape measurements". The waist chart (tap "Waist") clearly has all 5 points. Expected: the 4 cm waist drop used as the "main fat signal" the app itself talks about. Actual: ignored with a message saying I have no waist data. 
- Decision: `plan 2360`.

## Days 57–63 (batch)
- Sun 11-29 evening: target 2,360 → 2,350.
- Intake: 2,165 / 2,237 / 2,218 / 2,298 / 2,983 / 2,522 / 2,290. Scale 91.6 → 90.0 on Saturday — first time at 90!
- Nothing new on screen besides the 11-24 macro note that disappeared midweek.

## Week 9 (review Sun 2026-12-06, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.64 to −0.20 kg per week) includes your target of −0.46 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,360 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,830 ± 220 (Measured, 91%). Target 2,360. Avg 2,425. Rate -0.42 kg/week. Protein 141 g.
- Body comp: "Losing fat" (fat mass −3.2 kg ± 1.5; muscle −0.9 kg, no measurable change).
- The numbers have settled: maintenance 2,830–2,860 for 4 weeks now. I trust it.
- Decision: no change, keep `plan` at ~2,360 (same as last week).

## Days 64–70 (batch)
- Sun 12-06 evening target stayed 2,360.
- Intake: 2,226 / 2,079 / 2,572 / 2,308 / 2,776 / 2,149 / 2,413. Scale 90.3 → 89.5 (Thu).
- From Tue 12-08 the "30+ days since your last backup" banner came back (last backup 11-08). New macro warning for 12-12 (20% apart).

## Week 10 (review Sun 2026-12-13, morning)
- Backed up again from the banner → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-13.json. "Last backup: 2026-12-13".
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.67 to −0.25 kg per week) includes your target of −0.45 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,380 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,840 ± 210 (Measured, 92%). Target 2,380. Avg 2,383. Rate -0.46 kg/week — spot on.
- Today waist 90.3 cm, neck 40.0 (6th tape entry). After logging it, body composition jumped to **"Confidence: high — Losing fat. Scale and tape agree."** Waist (first 3 vs last 3 avg) 92.7 → 91.1 = −1.6 cm ± 1; BIA fat mass −3.5 kg; muscle −0.6 kg (no measurable change); weight −4.9 kg. US Navy estimate 17.6%.
- So it needed 6 waist readings (3 at each end). At my every-2-weeks habit that took 10 weeks, and all that time it said "No waist data to cross-check against", which was misleading. Also averaging the first 3 dilutes my real waist change (94.9 → 90.3 = −4.6 cm shows as −1.6 cm).
- Decision: `plan 2380`. Very happy: losing fat, muscle holding.

## Days 71–77 (batch)
- Sun 12-13 evening: target 2,380 → 2,410 (maintenance 2,880).
- Intake: 2,514 / 2,516 / 2,586 / 2,181 / 2,371 / 2,179 / 2,804. Scale 89.0 → 88.4 low → 89.1.

## Week 11 (review Sun 2026-12-20, morning)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.70 to −0.29 kg per week) includes your target of −0.45 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,450 kcal/day." PLUS a new note: **"Losing fat and some muscle. A smaller deficit, protein toward the upper end of your range, and regular resistance training help keep muscle."**
- Maintenance 2,910 ± 200 (Measured, 92%). Avg intake 2,440. Rate −0.50 kg/week.
- Body comp: "Confidence: medium — Losing fat and some muscle. … muscle has also dropped by more than the measurement noise." BIA muscle 35.3 → 33.7 = −1.5 kg with noise ± 1.5 (so it's AT the noise, not clearly more), and the same screen calls BIA muscle "low confidence (includes water)". Confidence dropped from high (last week) to medium. Home card: Fat ▼ 5.7 kg, Muscle ▼ 1.6 kg vs first reading.
- My thoughts: this is exactly what I don't want. I already train 6x/week and eat ~196 g protein, so the advice is partly already done, but a smaller deficit is easy. I'm a bit skeptical because my BIA muscle number has bounced 33.6–36.0 the whole time, and it's borderline (−1.5 vs ±1.5), but I'll play safe.
- Decision: Settings → weekly rate 0.5% → 0.35%, protein 1.8 → 2.2 g/kg. New target 2,580 kcal, protein 169 g. `plan 2580`.

## Days 78–84 (batch)
- Sun 12-20 evening: target 2,580 → 2,600 (maintenance 2,920).
- Intake: 2,750 / 2,195 / 2,914 / 2,288 / 2,513 / 3,040 / 2,963 (avg 2,666 — above even the new target). Scale 88.8 → 90.3 by the end, a bit up.
- Macro warning for 12-21 (25% apart).
- End of period (Sat 12-26, 22:00): Recommendation "On track (−0.71 to −0.31 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.31. Suggested 2,600." Maintenance 2,920 ± 200 (Measured, 93%). Rate −0.51 kg/wk. Protein 172 g target, I average 195 g.
- Body comp flipped back within a week: "Confidence: high — Losing fat; muscle no measurable change". BIA fat mass 27.8 → 19.7 = **−8.1 kg**, muscle −0.4 kg, but weight only −4.1 kg. Losing 8 kg of fat while only 4 kg lighter and muscle flat doesn't add up — my BIA's last three readings (21.4–22.2%) look way too low, and the app calls it "high confidence" anyway. Home card: Fat ▼ 9.1 kg, Body fat ▼ 8.6%. I don't believe it. The "losing some muscle" warning last week also came and went with BIA noise.

## End tasks
- Data screen (⇩ icon): 84 weigh-ins, 6 measurement entries, 332 food entries, 83 complete days.
- Full backup → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json (readable JSON, all my entries). Daily export "All data" + individual food entries → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. Also Weights CSV.
- Opened them: clean and easy to read. Things I noticed: day 1 has two weigh-ins (06:50, 94.6 both) — the profile's "current weight" was stored as a separate weigh-in without body fat. The weekly (not daily) update kept me calm, "Explain the math" is great for someone like me, the macro-vs-calorie check caught label weirdness, and the backup reminder is a good idea.
